title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Maintenance Required for Children after Khula 10672 views Q. TALAQ 2032 views Q. I am 30 years of age. I was married some 3 years ago. After few months of my marriage, for certain domestic problems, my brothers compelled me to divorce my wife. I did so [triple talaq]. 1919 views Q. Fatwa regarding rejoining after khula. 4853 views Q. Talaq pronounced to wife over phone without witness & without knowledge of her hayees who left house without my permission 9 months ago for no reason 6037 views Q. Please give me the answer of my question (1) If I say to my wife that today I am giving you a 'FIRST TALAQ", then in this position 5536 views Q. working in khula period 8333 views Q. Zaid was married to Fathima(revert), they have a female child, Zaid Divorces his wife after going through all the formalities with Qazi Sahab and also Marriage Registrar and were leaving separately, the lady completed her Idda period, and she has not gone in to any body's nikah during this period. Now Zaid wants to marry her back saying that he gave her only one Talaq. Can Zaid marry her. 2240 views Q. One of my friends is in a state of confusion regarding HAQ-e-Mahar. 3 years back he has done his NIKAH with a girl in his relation and he went to abroad for his studies. There was no RUKSATI and the girl was still living at her home. In the mean time the girl lost interest in my friend and she gave the reason that he is very conservative and religious. She was asking again and again for Talaq. In spite of a lot of negotiations from both families this relation was failed and finally last week my friend gave her Talaq on phone and in written. Now the question is, as I stated before there was no RUKSATI took place. Only NIKAH was done. The girl is un-touched. So, the boy have to pay HAQ-e-Mahar or not? 1842 views Q. My elder brother asked my mother about his wife, "I divorced her; I have no relation with her 1870 views Q. My friend's wife quarreled with his parents, so he became impatient and he said talaq talaq talaq to his wife.but he doesn't know that his wife would become haram for him.can they lead their married life again or not. 1982 views Q. Khula 2133 views Q. Talaaq matter 1767 views Q. My brother is going through bad marriage since last 16 years and he wants to divorce his wife they don't have any relationship and don't even live in the same bedroom my brother sleeps in hall and bhabhi in bedroom with children 2281 views Q. I hope Insha Allah, you will be able to advice in the right direction. Please look into the following case: One Mrs. XYZ sought Khul from her husband Mr. ABC after eight years of marital life. Mr. ABC approved the request for Khul of Mrs. XYZ and Khul took place. Before the Idda period was over, the woman XYZ realized her fault and requested again for Nikkah, which the man ABC has accepted. They got remarried as per the Islamic Sharia. Within 3 months of remarriage, the Husband Mr. ABC realized and warned her that she is not obedient and not behaving properly as a wife. Finally after a few days, the Husband ABC divorced her (XYZ) during Tohar condition one time for not fulfilling the marital requirements. Before the Idda period came to an end, the wife repented and they reconciled and got united again. Again after 5 months, Husband ABC divorced Mrs. XYZ for her not obedient attitude and for not fulfilling the marital requirements. Again the wife Mrs. XYZ said, she will try to be following the marital requirements of a wife and they got reunited again. Again after reunification, the same problems surfaced again. Now the husband wants to diverse her again. Now the question is if the Husband divorces now in Tohar condition, is it considered as first Talaq, or the Third talaq? 2101 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 56590 Country: India Title: Please guide me what i have to do. Question: My wife is very modern she always fights with me and does not respect my mother, do not pray salah. One day there was huge fighting between us and I warned her to shut her mouth but she did not care. Then I have given all 3 talaqs. I explained her we are strangers to each other from now onwards and she must have to leave me but she didn't agree and complaints her parents they are just like non Muslims they argued with me and registered a police complaint against me stating that I am demanding additional dowry. Finally we are together till now. At present I am in Saudi. Please suggest me what I have to do. Every time I am thinking that I am a big sinner who has ever lived on this earth. Please help me to come out from this gunah. Answer ID: 56590 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 73/70/B=01/1436) Since you have given three talaqs to your wife; hence she went out of your nikah and became a stranger for you. Now it is unlawful and haram for you to live together. Now Shariah halalah and then new nikah is necessary in order to live together. قال الله تعالى: فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلاَ تَحِلُّ لَهُ مِن بَعْدُ حَتَّىَ تَنكِحَ زَوْجاً غَيْرَهُ . الآية [البقرة : 230] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
